facebook.caption:
Fresh seafood feast for $15-30 a person. In Phu Quoc. At Hanh Nhung Luxury.

1,696 reviews say this place delivers. The name says luxury, the price says accessible. Grilled, steamed, stir-fried, the seafood here comes straight from local waters and lands on your table fast.

Street address: 82-84 30/4, Phú Quốc. Easy to find, hard to leave hungry.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
